title: Design Settings » Member Profile Pages
text:
## Design Settings » Member Profile Pages
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000079207

## Member Profile Pages
This article reviews the available settings to modify the layout of Member Profile Pages. To edit these settings navigate to
Settings
Design Settings
General
Additional Design Settings
Member Profile Pages .

## Visual Guide of the Member Profile Pages Settings
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134719841/original/ucRjr1-3zyZW7DATd0AA-DsgWqwOclJDlw.png?1700514659 | alt: ]

## 1. Profile Photo Style
The available options for the profile image are Standard and Circle.

## Standard Corners
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134719967/original/D5PScgGEle4f2-TLsrIle0VaI0QFoVCTCg.png?1700514767 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134719985/original/7whY0xNwTk7PFWXmKY31zvlgXdMcqP8i4Q.png?1700514782 | alt: ]

## Circled Corners
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134720132/original/4uwHEeeqVRiH_ryKa--2O9Ewo4Y82sAxNA.png?1700514929 | alt: ]

## 2. Profile Page Header
The available options to align the header in profile pages are: Full-Width Header Above Sidebar and Align Header with Sidebar.

## Full-Width Header Above Sidebar
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134720227/original/NS7K3w5VW8pPqqDHwupwkxZcoLAQqB-2dg.png?1700515059 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134720231/original/5Io2GfDwCGZvdWI70abnO_RD8IBMlNXGBg.png?1700515067 | alt: ]

## Align Header with Sidebar (Default)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134720316/original/-q5TYY7qL1PwCylQROG1t8s3eUMOVeF5RQ.png?1700515128 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134720317/original/qya1jSDAvv_rUhGr3rIvqmpEBpJfkk1TyA.png?1700515128 | alt: ]

## 3. Display Content in Tabbed Layout
The available options to display the content in the members profile pages are: Display Content n Separate Tabs (Default) and Stream All Content Without Tabs

## No - Stream All Content Without Tabs
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134720472/original/mm3XDR2cO4KofE206yODPJWClvD_d_pA4Q.png?1700515286 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134721230/original/obcr98xpvy5mnvkMqF4UB84OLnb0oy9QaQ.png?1700516034 | alt: ]

## Yes - Display Content in Separate Tabs (Default)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134720659/original/uFQCRqntoSceoNUohGs8FOZGFmek1MaCzg.png?1700515500 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134720661/original/4dt-3jE3lmOaH-XGt6C-LWv_FuWjlDIG9Q.png?1700515500 | alt: ]

## 4. Display Post Count in Tab Title
The available options are Yes - Display Post Count in Tab Title and No - Hide Post Count in Tab Title

## Yes - Display Post Count in Tab Title
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134721454/original/86Ktw_LnSXK0lanZJ7nmlKME2i9xltoJvg.png?1700516173 | alt: ]

## No - Hide Post Count in Tab Title
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134721578/original/Pj5LeDt30LFdvhyIGxYMuIMrm8k2iz2TWQ.png?1700516315 | alt: ]

The available options are Stack or Scroll
